items.summary: Remove the bouquet element currently rendered above the first romantic line in `TimedRomanticLines` (the bouquet image loaded from `/assets/generated/rose-bouquet-sketch.dim_1400x900.png`) so that nothing related to the bouquet is displayed there.

Add a single text emoji line containing exactly "🌹" directly above the first romantic line “I brought you a rose today…” in the `TimedRomanticLines` section, styled like the existing bottom emoji line (the 😍 line used in the final-stage lip-biting section), and make the 🌹 emoji a bit larger using font-size only (do not convert to an image).

Update the build-time generated-assets verification script (`frontend/scripts/verify-generated-assets.mjs`) so it no longer requires the removed bouquet asset (`rose-bouquet-sketch.dim_1400x900.png`) to be present for a successful build/deploy, while keeping verification for the envelope, Image 1, and Image 2 assets intact.
